{{Quote|Did you know that Mellichae is a prisoner here in Aurilia? Captain Sarguillo defeated him.|An Aurilia citizen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:A" />}}
The '''Aurilia prison''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] located in the hidden township of [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was guarded by [[Aurilia sentinel]]s.<ref name="SWG:A" />

==History==
{{Quote|I have had enough of the good Captain's hospitality.|Mellichae, to a spacer|<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
[[File:Mellichae.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Mellichae, imprisoned in the Aurilia prison.]]
The Aurilia prison was built after the reconstruction of the village, following the [[battle of Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]], leader of the [[Sith Shadows]], was held prisoner there after being captured by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarguillo]] during the battle.<ref name="SWG:A" />

Sometime later, a disoriented [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] who wandered into town was captured and detained in the prison after she attacked Sarguillo and his men.<ref name="SWG:TNH">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Nightsister Headdress|Dathomir}}</ref>

Around the same time, Aurilia was attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Mellichae made his escape from the prison. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents later visited the village, looking for a fragment of the [[Codex of Tython]], an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]], kept by Mellichae. Captain Sarguillo who was not able to track Mellichae himself pointed where to find the Dark Jedi. The agents eventually found Mellichae and a band of Sith Shadows and defeated them. They also recovered the piece of Holocron from the Dark Jedi. Afterward, Mellichae was once again returned to custody in Aurilia.<ref name="SWGTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aurilia prison appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Aurilia prison was added to the game along with the revamped city of [[W:c:swg:Aurilia|Aurilia]],<ref name="SWG:A" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
